title: A filter on a many-side column does not filter the one-side table of a single-direction relationship
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Sales[CustomerKey] = 3 ) )

source.quote: a filter on Customer automatically filters Sales, whereas a filter on Sales propagates neither to Product nor to Customer or Date
source.supports: with single-direction relationships a filter on Sales does not propagate to Product

source.quote: In a one-to-many relationship, the direction is always from the one-side of the relationship to the many-side
source.supports: the direction is one side to many side only

derivation: Customer 3 bought products 1 and 3 only (Sales rows 5 and 6), but Sales[ProductKey] -> Product[ProductKey] is single direction, so the filter on Sales[CustomerKey] stays on Sales. Product keeps its 4 rows.
notes: An engine that propagates both ways would give 2.
